summary: Pokémon release day for Delta Reign and the 30th Celebration boxes dominated the feed: long lines, sold-out shelves, scalpers and markups, plus a lot of 'show us your pulls' threads. Collector Crypt's token got listed on Coinbase, and several small online pack sites (Ripz, Drip, PackVault, BONKUJI) pitched Delta Reign rips straight at people who missed out in stores. Solflare posted a limited-time FIRE POKE pack that runs till Monday, and community accounts kept posting friendly Solflare Packs pulls. Grading and slab trust stayed in the news through a CNBC piece on PSA.

sources_note: Data from the x connector's full-archive post search and news search, covering 09:00 UTC on 6 Nov to 09:00 UTC on 7 Nov 2026. Likes, reposts, replies, quotes and follower counts are public_metrics as returned at fetch time; impressions quoted where noted. The pack-opening search was flooded by Fortnite x One Piece cup prize posts and Canadian restock bots, which were skipped. Third-party revenue figures are unverified. No Phygitals, Watch.fun, Rip.fun, Arena Club, Disney Pinnacle or Top Shot posts of note in the window. New creators were checked against collector-base.csv and recent archive files.
